store.summary: CC1101 Sub-GHz thermal waterfall, RSSI scope, OOK decoder and .sub studio
store.description: RF Heatmap turns your CardputerZero with Cap CC1101 into a fast, intuitive Sub-GHz spectrum lab. Sweep 315, 433, 868, 915 MHz or all ISM bands with a live peak-hold bar graph and Inferno thermal waterfall, lock onto active bursts with one key, inspect pulses with an adjustable squelch oscilloscope, decode Princeton/CAME/Linear OOK frames, and manage Flipper-compatible .sub captures.
